title: Beyond Benchmarks: Exposing the Hidden Crisis in Bangla Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating benchmark-trained models on a newly annotated real-world dataset to measure misclassifications of culturally coded language, sarcasm, informal linguistic patterns, and emoji-based cues.
Qualitative analysis of false positives (over-policing) to identify the misclassification of legitimate political expression, criticism, and political satire as hate speech.
Qualitative examination of implicit hate speech examples to demonstrate model failure in detecting gender-biased victim-blaming and implicit sexual shaming.
Cross-dataset validation comparing model performance on highly structured, explicit benchmark datasets versus a noisy, informal, and implicitly hateful real-world social media dataset.
